subsections.text: Gameplay and software developer experienced in building and shipping PC, mobile, and web-based interactive applications. Specializes in gameplay systems, physics, technical architecture, and rapid prototyping using Unity and C\#. Proven ability to take ownership of existing codebases, refactor scalable systems, collaborate across teams, and deliver production-ready projects presented at public conventions and academic venues.

subsections.title: Road-safety Mobile Game ( Metrocycle 2.0 )
subsections.subtitle: Team of 3 | Published (the academe, itch.io), Thesis, Unity 3D, C#, Android, GitHub
items: Expanded Metrocycle, a web-based motorcycle road-safety game, into a production-ready Android educational application.
Refactored and extended a large existing Unity codebase, improving scalability, maintainability, and feature extensibility.
Led Android porting and mobile optimization efforts, restoring broken systems and improving usability across devices.
Engineered a centralized localization system supporting multilingual educational content and scalable UI integration.
Implemented modular gameplay systems including weather effects, avatar customization, and reusable minigame frameworks.
Redesigned UI/UX systems for accessibility, readability, and clearer player feedback during road-safety scenarios.
Co-managed GitHub workflows, technical documentation, and collaborative development practices within a 3-person team.
Published and presented the project at the Workshop on Computation: Theory and Practice (WCTP 2025) in Hokkaido, Japan.

subsections.title: Endless Runner Word-Puzzle ( involuntary: Odd-One-Out )
subsections.subtitle: Published (Google Play Store, itch.io), Unity 3D, C#, Android, IronSource, Unity Ads
items: Designed and developed a mobile endless runner combining word-puzzle mechanics with fast-paced gameplay loops.
Integrated monetization systems using IronSource and Unity Ads, including rewarded, banner, and interstitial flows.
Conducted closed beta testing with 10+ external testers, iterating on gameplay balance, UX clarity, and progression pacing.
Managed the full mobile release pipeline from prototyping and playtesting to Google Play Store deployment.

subsections.title: Narrative-driven Adventure Game ( Life as a Marites )
subsections.subtitle: Team of 2 | Published (itch.io), Unity 3D, C#, TextMeshPro, Unity Version Control, Windows
items: Built a 3D narrative-driven adventure game inspired by Filipino gossip culture and branching social interactions.
Implemented gameplay systems including dialogue flow, branching choices, scoring logic, and dynamic text presentation.
Developed UI and interaction systems using TextMeshPro for responsive dialogue rendering and player feedback.
Collaborated closely with a designer to structure branching narratives and player decision consequences.
Maintained a detailed Game Design Document (GDD) covering gameplay systems, narrative structure, timelines, and production.

subsections.title: Time-Manipulation Puzzle Platformer ( heavenly hatdogs )
subsections.subtitle: Published (itch.io), Game Jam, Unity 3D, C#, Windows/Mac
items: Developed a 3D time-manipulation puzzle platformer centered around physics-driven gameplay systems.
Implemented a custom player controller supporting gravity handling, slope movement, grounded states, and double jumping.
Iterated the project from a short game jam prototype into a polished convention-ready demo build.
Presented the game at ConQuest 2023, gathering direct player usability feedback for later gameplay improvements.
